reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it directs viewers to stake tokens through an external page (gwei.vertaisushi.top) rather than the SUSHI platform it names, asking them to connect a wallet and stake for a stated return of up to 952% APY. The speaker presents the offer as "a golden ticket to earn tokens" and "an excellent way to earn a safe and accurate passive income," and stresses that "there is no risk of blocking of your balance," tying an implausibly high yield to a requested deposit. The educational disclaimer and the risk warning in the description do not change the solicitation the video makes.

I'm looking at a new token project that allows me to get 952% apy profit per year through staking.
I'm going to stake all my tokens. It's about 20,000. You can get a token reward receive about 540 tokens each time.
The next step is to connect another wallet. Make sure that your wallet is connected to the bank, just click on Connect Wallet.
All right, it's been 24 hours. It was just a few seconds. Let's look at the profit.

opening.argument: The presentation expressly frames itself as education rather than investment advice and tells viewers to investigate independently and invest only what they can afford to lose. That is meaningful qualification, not an unconditional promise. The description specifically warns that cryptocurrency investment is high risk and that very high APY may mean substantial risk. The speaker also says viewers should check the results themselves. Read as a risk-disclosed demonstration, the material does not conceal uncertainty or present participation as guaranteed or safe for everyone.

citations.quote: 본 영상은 교육 목적의 정보 제공이며 투자 조언이 아닙니다. 암호화폐 투자는 고위험을 동반합니다. 매우 높은 APY는 큰 리스크를 의미할 수 있습니다.
반드시 스스로 조사(DYOR)하고, 손실을 감당할 수 있는 금액만 투자하세요.
Please check the results yourself.
The reason I'm talking about this video is for educational purposes and does not provide any investment advice.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited yield and wallet-connection language show what the walkthrough discusses, but they do not erase the prominent risk disclosure. A disclaimer cannot prove a service is safe, yet the issue here is whether the presentation is deceptive; the warning expressly identifies high APY as risky and directs viewers to do their own research. The prosecution also treats the linked page as an established mechanism, while the cited material only gives the link and describes the process.

citations.quote: 매우 높은 APY는 큰 리스크를 의미할 수 있습니다.
반드시 스스로 조사(DYOR)하고, 손실을 감당할 수 있는 금액만 투자하세요.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A disclaimer does not neutralize the actual message. The same description asks viewers to stake GWEI for up to 952% APY, while the narration calls the opportunity a golden ticket and says it is safe and accurate passive income. Telling viewers to research risks is inconsistent with presenting the outcome as real, enormous, and worth trying. The warning therefore functions as a qualification around a direct high-return solicitation, not as a correction of it.

opening.argument: The material is structured as an operational staking guide: it explains connecting a wallet, selecting the staking action, confirming a transaction, checking the balance, and using Unstake. The description explicitly calls it a step-by-step practical guide and says it includes a measured 24-hour demonstration and results analysis. The frames likewise show a presenter beside a staking interface, including stake and unstake panels. This is instructional coverage of a crypto tool and a claimed personal test, so the educational and demonstration context is central rather than incidental.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The presence of a link and a walkthrough does not by itself convert a tutorial into deceptive solicitation. The description labels the content educational, and the frames show a staking interface rather than proof of a hidden credential request or an independently verified financial outcome. The prosecution's interpretation relies on treating every instructional step as an endorsement, even though the material also presents a process viewers can inspect and evaluate.

citations.quote: 본 영상은 교육 목적의 정보 제공이며 투자 조언이 아닙니다.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Calling the video a guide does not change what the guide instructs viewers to do. It directs them to the supplied page, connect a wallet, stake roughly 20,000 tokens, and pursue a stated 952% annual return. The interface and transaction sequence make the solicitation actionable; they do not independently verify that the pool exists, that rewards are genuine, or that withdrawal works. A demonstration of claimed results is still not evidence that the offer is legitimate.

citations.quote: 지갑 연결, 풀 선택, Stake(스테이크) 버튼 클릭, 언제든 가능한 Unstake(언스테이크) 방법까지 실전으로 보여드립니다.
I'm going to stake all my tokens. It's about 20,000.
The next step is to connect another wallet. Make sure that your wallet is connected to the bank, just click on Connect Wallet.

opening.argument: The observable mechanism is a token-staking service walkthrough, not a request for passwords, private keys, recruitment fees, or downline payments. The stated action is to connect a wallet and use a Stake control, followed by an Unstake control. The speaker says the balance remains under the user's control and can be returned through the wallet, while the frames show an interface offering both staking and unstaking. Whatever one thinks of the advertised rate, the supplied evidence does not establish credential theft, forced lockup, recruitment, or a guaranteed cash payout.

citations.quote: All the currency and profits can be returned instantly through the wallet.
There is no risk of blocking of your balance. It will always maintain complete control of your balance.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The evidence does not need to show a password request or recruitment scheme to establish a staking-return promotion. The prosecution's own quotes identify the relevant mechanism: viewers are directed to an external page, asked to connect a wallet, and encouraged to stake tokens for 952% APY. The absence of a private-key request is therefore not a defense to a deposit-based return claim, and the speaker's assurances about instant return are unverified assertions.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing mechanisms are not the point: the video plainly promotes depositing tokens into a staking pool for extraordinary returns. The claim that funds can be unstaked instantly is only the speaker's statement, and the displayed interface cannot establish that the external page is affiliated with SUSHI or that its rewards are withdrawable. Saying there is no balance lock therefore adds an unverified assurance to an actionable token deposit request.
